symptom: Read, Write and Edit rows with file pills sat further apart than Bash rows: the inner disclosure kept its 28px minimum inside the padded group, so those rows stood 36px tall and calls sat 36 or 44px apart.
rule: The disclosure inside a ListRowGroup drops its own minimum height (LIST_ROW_IN_GROUP has min-h-0), so every tool row is 28px on one 36px pitch; the smoke asserts the height of each kind.
